capabilities: Upload the entire vault to Dropbox every 20 minutes
Trigger a manual backup from the ribbon icon
Authenticate the plugin with a Dropbox account
Exclude binary files from backups via a setting
Show backup status through icon states during upload
extras: Renamed from 'Dropbox Backups' in version 2.0.0 to follow required branding guidelines. Backups are write-only and scoped to a single Dropbox folder; non-text files (anything other than md, org, txt) are uploaded as binaries.
problem: Obsidian keeps vaults as local files with no built-in offsite backup, so a device failure or accidental deletion can lose notes.
summary: Automated backup plugin that uploads the entire vault to a Dropbox folder every 20 minutes, with manual trigger and upload status icons.
